packs.name: Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup (CC0 32x32)
packs.description: Comprehensive 6,185-sprite CC0 32x32 orthogonal tileset covering dungeon terrain, monsters, weapons, armor, spells, effects, and GUI icons.
